reportsAreas.title: Sales by area
reportsAreas.sub: Where the shop sells and where parcels come back: delivered orders by district, upazila or area inside Dhaka, with the return rate of each.

table.title: Area by area
table.sub: Highest Sales first. Return rate = returned ÷ (delivered + returned) in this period.
table.unknownHow: Orders with no area, or an address that does not reach this level.
table.outsideHow: Orders to addresses outside the city.
table.empty: No delivered or returned orders in this period.
table.cut: Only the first {n} areas are listed; the CSV has every area.

map.title: Map
map.sub: Each circle is an area: the bigger, the more Sales; the redder, the more parcels came back (the reddest is the highest return rate on this map). Areas without a map point are only in the table.
map.none: None of these areas has a map point yet (Delivery → Places).
map.label: {name}: Sales {sales}, {pct}

reportsAreas.how: Sales counts delivered orders only, on their delivered day; returns on the day the parcel came back. With a category or product chosen, only its share of each order counts.
